description: Publish a project: it goes live on its page and, when public, on Projects and Jobs. Refused, with the same message the Studio editor shows, while the checklist is incomplete (title, logline, description, project type, location or remote, shoot dates or dates flexible, at least one role); the answer lists each open item with the tool that completes it (update_project or add_project_role). Also refused by the live-projects cap and while a project is under review. Publishing a closed project reopens it.

project_id.description: The project's id (from list_projects or create_project).

name: publish_project
title: Publish project
